# agentic-identity

People, agents, and the access they share: delegation, invites, links, and an audit trail.

Status: 0.5.0 preview. Principals and delegation, sharing (roles, invites, links, audit), six ports (Store, Blobs, Auth, Realtime, Mail, Queue), memory and Cloudflare D1/R2 adapters, contract suites at agentic-identity/testing. HTTP API (agentic-identity/worker) with OIDC sign-in, API keys, personal access tokens, and data export and delete. Typed SDK at agentic-identity/sdk. Shared bearer check at agentic-identity/http: `requirePrincipal(request, auth, { kinds?, scope?, origins? })` returns the principal or a 401/403/503 Response. A write that rides on the session cookie needs an Origin listed in `origins`, or it is a 403; a bearer key needs none. No CLI or MCP server yet.
